summary: Verify dynamic version diagnostics at the package boundary

delivery.outcome: Verify dynamic Python version diagnostics through the process and wheel boundaries and publish the material integration as Goal 2.2.9.
nonGoals: No application path edits or duplicate publisher
No network upload in regression fixtures
No runtime dependency or adoption changes
No CI pin or independent approval bypass

architecture.decision: Application ticket-230 owns the static version diagnostic repair. Integration adds a fresh Python child process over a dynamic initializer that must never execute. Check report/auto-fix and real VERSION mismatch cases, then enforce exact byte parity for the packaged diagnostic module. Join only root version projections; preserve every other lock record. Publish exact independently accepted CI input pins before full validation.
architecture.rollback: Independent protected revert; existing immutable registry versions are never overwritten.

commands: Actual installed Goal 2.2.8 fails the dynamic fallback subprocess contract
Accepted application source passes four report/sync cases without importing the project
Installed wheel parity and observer integration suite
Native governance and actual Goal -a delivery
Independently accepted exact OneDev input profile
Required exact-current-base checks and Validator merge
Goal publication and verified public artifacts
